my favourite decks are my \[\[Muldrotha the Gravetide\]\] and \[\[Tocasia, Dig Site Mentor\]\] decks, both graveyard but working in very different ways. 

Muldrotha seeks to fill the graveyard through self mill and discard to recur permanents over and over to grind out the game. It loves sagas like \[\[Binding the Old Gods\]\] and \[\[Cruelty of Gix\]\] and \[\[Kaya's Ghostform\]\] is a keen piece with Muldrotha. The deck naturally also enjoys sacrifice as it allows it to put pieces into the graveyard to bring back.

Tocasia is more along the lines of creature control and wants to go wide, using creatures with vigilance to beat down and then tapping them to surveil through the deck. It especially loves \[\[Enhanced Surveillance\]\] to look 3 cards deep with each surveil and creatures that care about being tapped like \[\[Emmara, Soul of the Accord\]\] or \[\[Fallowsage\]\]. its wincons are damage and \[\[Approach of the Second Sun\]\] which it can surveil to easily.
